answer.label: Attributed to — Sutton’s accounts conflict
answer.sourceLine: QI documents a related bank-robber remark from Paul Perritt in 1923, a Sutton credit in 1951, a reported 1952 use and Sutton’s later denial. The record is more complicated than either a secure Sutton original or a proved fabrication.
